method.duration: 180 elapsed seconds per revision after the first natural timer poll
method.execution: Independent server/browser processes measured during overlapping windows; CPU is per-server ps time, not host CPU
method.isolation: Private fixture copies, tests/conftest.py state overrides, loopback only, external browser requests blocked, Orca disabled
method.transport: Sandbox Funnel registry selects the production metadata no-store branch on baseline; loopback HTTP, no live TLS/proxy changes
method.bytes: Compressed response bodies and HTTP response wire bytes including headers; excludes bootstrap, TLS and TCP overhead
method.routes: Five actual idle GETs observed; metadata supplies project/delivery summaries, no board configured, review document rather than plan tab
method.fixture_note: The supplied copy contains 191 version files/history entries, rather than the task description's 265; source metadata 937735 B, private owner-stripped copy 936659 B
method.timer_note: Unmodified 2.27.2 shell.js, actual adaptive 8/15/30 second timers, no synthetic refresh or fetch loop

before.notes: Real browser timers, warmed bootstrap excluded; private copy and isolated state, no external traffic; no synthetic polling.

after.notes: Real browser timers, warmed bootstrap excluded; private copy and isolated state, no external traffic; no synthetic polling.

validation.coverage: All ten poll route families, exact representation SHA-256, gzip/identity, 304 empty bodies, meta/project/owner/delivery invalidation, auth/session isolation and key rotation, bounded cache
